name: 1606 Corp.
summary: 1606 Corp. is an artificial intelligence chatbot firm specializing in e-commerce solutions tailored for the cannabidiol (CBD) industry. Its flagship offering, ChatCBDW, is a proprietary conversational AI platform seamlessly integrated to elevate sales performance, enlighten consumers about product specifics, and deliver valuable analytics regarding customer preferences and behavioral patterns, concurrently supporting efficient inventory management. This enterprise was established in 2019 and operates from its main office in Phoenix, Arizona.
